definitions.gloss: loading, mounting, equipping; equipped with, onboard
definitions.explanation: The act of installing or loading equipment, features, or cargo onto a vehicle, device, or system. Commonly used in technology and transportation contexts to describe built-in features.

examples.japanese: このスマホにはAIが{搭載|とうさい}されている。
examples.english: This smartphone is equipped with AI.

examples.japanese: {新型|しんがた}の{車|くるま}には{最新|さいしん}の{安全機能|あんぜんきのう}が{搭載|とうさい}されている。
examples.english: The new car model is equipped with the latest safety features.

examples.japanese: この{人工衛星|じんこうえいせい}には{高性能|こうせいのう}カメラが{搭載|とうさい}されており、{地表|ちひょう}の{細|こま}かい{様子|ようす}まで{撮影|さつえい}できる。
examples.english: This satellite is equipped with a high-performance camera that can photograph fine details on the ground.

notes:
{搭載|とうさい} is very commonly used in product descriptions and tech journalism to describe features that are built into or loaded onto a device or vehicle.

PATTERN:
- 〜を{搭載|とうさい}する: to equip with ~, to install ~
- 〜が{搭載|とうさい}されている: ~ is equipped / comes loaded with
- 〜{搭載|とうさい}: ~-equipped (used as a modifier, e.g., AI{搭載|とうさい})

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- エンジンを{搭載|とうさい}する: to mount an engine
- {機能|きのう}を{搭載|とうさい}する: to include a feature
- {搭載|とうさい}{量|りょう}: payload capacity
- {搭載|とうさい}モデル: a model equipped with ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {装備|そうび}: equipment, gear (broader; includes personal gear and military equipment)
- {積|つ}む: to load, to pile up (more general; less technical)
